title: the global forwarding residue reads a berth charted on another box by its commons copy
intention: forwarding_residue(None) reads its orient, constrain and survey berths through chain's stage_packet_paths (ticket 6241d0daec15), so the global report counts what every box charted.
why: Law 7 (a diagnostic surface reading short is a red, gating or not): 2026-11-19 on akiendelllinux, by /home/akien/.cairn/devices/cc/0/scratch/akiendelllinux_cc_0/skillseals/measure_residue_none.py: one orient berth with an unresolvable ref. Held in the local chart store, forwarding_residue(None) asks 1 pair and leaves 1 unanswered; held only in the commons mirror, it asks 0. The global report (cairn/devices/codemother/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py:906, read by cairn/devices/codemother/machines/build_inspector/probes/does_the_derivation_keep_up.py) globs _CHART_BERTHS alone, and live, 308 of the 3367 CairnCommons/berths/chart berths are absent from this box's store. Chain publishes only per-ticket readers (claiming_packet_paths, claiming_packets); listing every berth at a stage, carried ones included, has no public reader in cairn/tools/chain/chain.py. Sibling of ad3aece2650b (the per-component mode), 072a482e6dd7, 1e99a571dd6d, 7cae18f7f9c2.
traces_to: Law 7; RULE 1 (one reader, the chain tool's)
how: In cairn/devices/codemother/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py forwarding_residue: when comp_dir is None, read each stage's paths from cairn.tools.chain.chain.stage_packet_paths (built by 6241d0daec15) instead of _CHART_BERTHS.glob; the per-ticket filter and everything after stay. Proof shape: /home/akien/.cairn/devices/cc/0/scratch/akiendelllinux_cc_0/skillseals/measure_residue_none.py.

clauses.claim: forwarding_residue(None) asks the same (address, ticket) pair for a berth held only in the commons mirror as for one held locally
a claimless local berth is still asked under no ticket, as before

decisions.text: D1: forwarding_residue(None) iterates chain.stage_packet_paths(stage) in place of the _CHART_BERTHS glob (needs 6241d0daec15 PROVED).
D2: red-first proof cairn/devices/codemother/machines/build_inspector/proofs/test_the_global_forwarding_residue_reads_carried_berths.py, one tooth per clause.
